text:
The bug is in `tenacity/stop.py`, `stop_after_attempt.__call__`. The predicate currently returns `True` only when `retry_state.attempt_number > self.max_attempt_number`, so the retry loop permits an extra attempt after reaching the configured limit. The stop evaluation flow in `tenacity/__init__.py` confirms the predicate is checked after each failed attempt, making the boundary inclusive when the predicate uses `>=`.

I intend to change the comparison from `>` to `>=`, leaving the stop composition and retry flow unchanged.
